description: Request an action for a registered image ID: hard_reload, retry, evict_disk, flash, prove_savings or a supported simulation override. swap_url requires url; restore removes the override. Support depends on the component and platform. prove_savings attempts a WebP conversion at displayed size and reports available byte comparisons and a device-local URI; inspect visual quality and originalBytesSource before using the result. Other actions return an acknowledgement and, when available, a later record snapshot; that snapshot may precede load completion. A device-local URI is not necessarily accessible from the editor host.

deviceId.description: The device to act on: its id from list_devices or from your instructions. Pass it whenever more than one app may be connected. Once a call names a device, later calls in this session use it when deviceId is left out.

name: image_action
